entities.name: Query CoaBC
observations: 404 aa; estimated molecular weight 44.3 kDa and theoretical pI 6.64.
Pfam matches: flavoprotein domain PF02441 at residues 6–181 and DFP domain PF04127 at residues 190–398.
Sequence is strongly homologous to curated bacterial CoaBC proteins: 43.6–44.8% identity over 92–95% coverage, E-values 1.1e-94 to 2.8e-92.

entities.name: Coenzyme A biosynthesis
observations: Query CoaBC is assigned to the CoA biosynthetic pathway, catalyzing steps 2 and 3 from pantothenate.

entities.name: CoaBC ligase reaction
observations: 4'-Phosphopantothenate + L-cysteine + CTP → 4-phosphopantothenoylcysteine + CMP + diphosphate + H(+). EC 6.3.2.5; Rhea RHEA:19397.

entities.name: FMN
observations: Curated CoaBC homologs bind one FMN per subunit.

entities.name: Mg2+
observations: Curated CoaBC homologs use Mg2+ as a cofactor or catalytic metal.

entities.name: Bacterial CoaBC homolog
observations: Reviewed homologs O35033, P0ABQ0, and P0ABQ1 are bifunctional CoaBC enzymes with an N-terminal phosphopantothenoylcysteine decarboxylase region and C-terminal phosphopantothenate-cysteine ligase region.
E. coli CoaBC is annotated as a homododecamer; the CoaC region drives dodecamer formation and the CoaB region forms homodimers.
